limits: Finite declared-rival and seed/count audit only; it does not prove universal identifiability or owner acceptance. Width 30 is outside the odd-width axis grammar.

witness_case.counterfactual_program:
(rule! (let ((dummy 0))
  (let* ((axis (first (filter (lambda (c)
                                (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 9))
                                      (range (rows g))))
                              (range (cols g)))))
         (colors (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 9))))
                         (grid-colors g)))
         (rarest (first (sort-by colors
                                 (lambda (v) (length (find-color g v)))))))
    (for*/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range (rows g))) (c (in-range axis)))
      (let ((v (at g r c)) (mc (- (* 2 axis) c)))
        (if (and (= v rarest) (in-bounds? r mc (rows g) (cols g)))
            (set-cell out r mc v)
            out))))))

dependency.step_a: scan the source half, count each nonzero non-axis color, and produce the policy-selected eligible color set
dependency.step_b: reflect exactly the source cells whose colors are in the eligible set across the discovered 9 axis
